description: Retrieve the status or administrator reply for one previously submitted public-demo observation. Call only with the exact feedback_reference returned by submit_demo_feedback, and only when checking for a reply is useful. If no feedback was submitted, skip this optional tool. Never invent a reference or poll repeatedly.

feedback_reference.description: Exact 24-character reference returned by a successful submit_demo_feedback call. Required for this optional lookup; never invent it.

name: get_demo_feedback_reply
title: Check an optional feedback reply
